tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar kha skong ngo mtshar 'od brgya'i bang mdzod dad 'dun yid kyi shing rta ngoms par byed pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/namaḥsarba gu ru ā nanda ratna sā dā ya/ yang rnam thar shin tu bsdus pa bris thang gi phyir du go bsla bar brjod pa/ swa sti/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i lung bstan las// li tsa gzhon nu klu sgrub skyu ra zhes// sidgha gling gi dgra bcom gyis bskul ltar// paṇa chen shākya shrīs ngos bzung bstod la 'dud// skyob pa des kyang gser khang bka' chems su// nga nyid gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba la// shing 'di st+wa yu ste'u yu pher dus kyi// khri thog bcu gsum dus 'ong gsung la 'dud// u rgyan gu ru'i gter kha kun las kyang*// zhang tshan 'khrugs dus rab brtan lha bab rgyud// slar yang gdul bya skyong zhes lung bstan bzhin// spyan mnga' bcu gsum dus skye bzhes la 'dud// phyag na rdo rjes bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs// rdo rje phag mos dus 'khor lha tshogs spros// mtsho rdol rnga brdungs yab yum rmi ltas bcas// gser khang sku 'drar 'od zer bcas pa dang*// sgru nang bkra shis lumbir bltams la 'dud// byis pa'i rol rtsed zol gyis chos 'chad dang*// sgom tshul ston dang tshe sngon skyes rabs gtam// klu sgrub skyu ra'i rnam thar gsungs ji bzhin// phyi dus 'khor rnams yid ches mdzad la 'dud// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod thugs nas rang shar 'don// yi ge'i phyi mo brda tsam phul 'phral dgongs// dud 'gro sogs la bcos min thugs rje'i nyams// dam can sogs kyis skyob par bkur la 'dud// lo bcu bzhes tshe yum la chos bstan zhing*// nye ba'i rdo rje tsher ma snyel tshul la'ang*// zhi khro'i tshogs dang sman bla snyun gsol bas// sprul par yid ches mtshe'u khar spyan drangs 'dud// rigs yab gsang bdag sprul pa dbyings bsdus tshe// khu bo'i mdun sar mi rtag skyo shas gtam// sngon gyi bag chags slad tshul zhus pa las// rjes bzung thub bstan khang par btsud la 'dud// bcu gnyis lo bzhes gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang dus// karma pa dang lugs gnyis dga' ston gyis// zu re'i bkra shis chos thang du mdzad pas/

lha mi'i bsod nams tshogs chen spel la 'dud// slad ma'ang dbang gi mtshan ldan khu bo'i drung*// 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod ji snyed dang*// kyai rdor sogs rgyud rtsis sogs sbyangs tshul gyis// rin chen chos kyi lhun po brtsegs la 'dud// dbang gi thugs dam sprul sku'i lha chen la// karma pa dang lhan gcig rab gnas tshe// ye shes pa nyid der thim ltas bzang pos// dag snang rab 'byams 'ba' zhig 'char mdzad 'dud// rgyal sras de dang mtshe'u khar gdan 'dzoms rjes// byang du'ang mjal dus sngon gyi dpon slob dran// karma pa nyid yid ches dad pa yis/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon por bsgrags la 'dud// bcu gsum lo bzhes khyim nas rab byung tshul// skal bzang 'dun pa'i srol 'dzin kun dga' blos// ngur smrig gos dang bslab bcu'i khrims gnang ste// 'gro kun dga' mdzad rin chen mtshan gsol 'dud// mkhas grub gtsang pa'i zhabs las chos drug dang*// rim lnga sbyor drug sogs gsan tshul bstan tshe// bde drod nyams 'bar rtags bcu chos skyong gzigs// rdzu 'phrul rol rtsed mgur dbyangs mdzad la 'dud// grub chen blo gros dpal la'ang bsnyen sgrub sogs// mang thos zhabs las rngog chos skor sogs gsan// nyi shu'i lo dus chos lung tshogs pa las// bsnyen par rdzogs nas chos mang gsan la 'dud// de lta'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag bla ma rnams// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin bsten pas// bcol nor len ltar rang nor longs spyod kyis// mchog thun dngos grub slar brnyes tshul bstan 'dud// dgung lo nyi shu lon bar gdul bya'i ngor// mkhas btsun bzang por smin tshul bstan nas slar// skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i chos khri'i steng*// phebs te lhar bcas skye dgus bstod la 'dud// skyob pa'i nyi ma 'bri gung shar ri'i rtse// shar ba'i mod la mnga' 'og 'dab brgya'i tshal// log lta'i gnyid sangs bsnyen bkur ge sar rgyas// bka' brgyud bstan pa nyin mor mdzad la 'dud// legs smon 'brel ldan 'dzam gling mi mang po// zhal mthong gsung thos mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// thar pa'i sa bon phan bde'i lo 'bras rgyas// wā rā ṇa sīr chos gsungs bzhin la 'dud// dus de nas brtsams 'khor 'dus ches mang la// las 'bras gtam dang zab mo stong pa nyid// bstan snying dgongs gcig gis mtshon chos kyi char// rgyun du phab pas drang nges bstan la 'dud// gdul bya mchog la bsam gtan grub pa'i rtags// chos drug gtum mo'i ras phud dga' ston dus// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'khor bzhes pa sogs// kun la mthun grub rten 'brel bdag por 'dud// ya mtshan me tog lha yis phul ba'i brdar// nas kyi rdog po 'gron bu tsam che mngon// sgrub sde'i khang bu bzhi brgyar nye ba ru// sgrub tshugs rten 'brel bzang pos tshugs la 'dud// nor 'dod 'phongs la zang zing sbyin brgya gnang*// chos 'dod dman la blor bstun gang 'kho'i chos// mchog la mos gus srog sogs zab khrid kyis// don bsgrubs 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos la 'dud// khyod kyis gdul bya shākya'i rgyal po ltar// bla ma'i tshogs la'ang phar la chos mang bstan// jo gdan tshogs pa nyan thos dge 'dun 'bum// dzo ki la sogs thag ring 'gron bskyabs 'dud// bod 'brog mi dang bya dang ri dwags sogs// kun kyang bsdu ba rnam bzhis bskyangs dus der// lhas kyang chos nyan me tog char chen phab// mtshe'u thang bya rgod phung por chos bstan 'dud// byang hor gdug can btul te bu nor phul// sgom khyung sog rong 'bab sogs so so'i sdes// dad pas spyan drangs yod dgu 'bul bar bstabs// 'brel tshad don ldan chos sbyor mdzad la 'dud// 'byor tshogs de yang rdzas rten bsod nams rgyur// rin chen las bskrun rgyud 'bum thog mar bzhengs// phyi nas bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur cog bsgrubs// sgrub rgyags sogs kyis thar par bsngos la 'dud// rten 'brel des kyang skyob pa'i zhing khams 'dir// mnga' ris dbus gtsang mdo khams grwa rgyun 'dus// 'phags yul rgya nag sogs su'ang cher grags pas// 'bul dpon rjes 'brangs grwa mang 'dus la 'dud// mthil 'di'i dar rgyas gong nas gong brtsegs te// sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang gsar bzhengs shing*// grwa rgyun gsar spel sngar nas rgyun brtan sogs// rdzu 'phrul rab gnas rten 'brel bsgrigs la 'dud// stag lung tshe dbang grags pa'i yar 'dren du// spyan drangs nyis stong bdun brgya'i 'dus bcas pa'i// skye dgu gdul bya'i zhing du smin mdzad cing*// mgon gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres la 'dud// sde pa sgar pa 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyis// mgon 'di'i zhabs pad gtsug tu blangs gyur te// zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin dang chabs gcig par// lha sar chos kyi 'brug stong bsgrags la 'dud// dus der skye dgu'i nad yams rgyun chad pas// sgar chen rgyal po snying nas dad pa skyes// lus dang longs spyod bstabs nas 'dzam gling 'di'i// gnas gsum nyer bzhi'i mnga' dbul phul la 'dud// nyin re bzhin yang sa skyong de nyid kyi// ral pa'i khri la rgyal dbang gnyis zhabs blangs// sprul sku des kyang skyob pa khyod nyid la// dbang lung mang phul bstan pa gtad la 'dud// yon mchod gdan 'dzom po ta lar mjal dus// rdzu 'phrul du mas lha mi'i mchod rdzas bzhes// phyir lam chu bo'i ri la phyag nas kyis// klu dbang bstan srung dam bca' bzhes la 'dud// gnas 'dir phebs rjes yang dag 'jog ngang nas// sgom khyung 'thab rtsod zhi ba'i cho 'phrul bstan// gnas gsum ri bo'i spo la'ang sgrub brgyud pa// nyis stong sogs kyi sngar srol gsos la 'dud// u rgyan padma 'byung gnas lung bstan bzhin// 'gro nad me chu'i gnod sel zhi ba'i las// rang srid mi g.yo chos 'phel rgyas pa'i las// bdud 'dul drag las mngon sum bstan la 'dud// dbang gi las kyis 'khor 'das dbang bsdud grogs// yum drung nyid dang mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal// a phyi nyid dang ye shes mgon pos byin// phyi nang phrin las srung mas bsgrubs la 'dud// rten 'brel sgrig phyir sprul skus gnas 'dir phebs// thugs kyi gdams ngag lhag ma slar yang phul// gsung gi bka' bgros bshad sgrub yar phyir tsho'i// bstan pa'i gnyer gtad rab gnas mdzad la 'dud// dus der rgyal ba'i gsung gi gdung 'tshob bka'// 'gyur ro cog rnams rin chen rgyu las bzhengs// bka' rgyud lung 'bum bcas pa'i bstan 'gyur yang*// sngon med rin chen glegs bam bskrun la 'dud// sngar 'brel can gyi 'dan ma gu ge dang*// gzhan yang ris med khams dbus rgyal khams pa// rgya nag rgyal po'i rta 'bul dpon sogs kyis// srog chags bcas nor bgrang yas phul la 'dud// skabs de nyid na gu ru'i gter yig bzhin// zhang dbon 'khrugs las phyogs 'dir rgol rtsom pa'i// bdud tshogs 'khor bcas rim gyis tshar gcod pa// 'jig rten phal pas mngon sum grub la bdud// slar yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag sprul// zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i spyan sngar phebs lam du// bka' brgyud srog 'dzin sprul sku stag lung pa'i// bsnyen bkur bzhes nas thugs yid bsres la 'dud// bde chen yangs pa can du 'khor mang bcas// sprul sku rnam gnyis gdan 'dzom dga' ston tshe// lha rdzas me tog kha ba ltar babs sogs// lha mi'i chen pos sri zhus bstod la 'dud// byang phyogs ru sde rnams kyis spyan drangs bzhin// skal dman yongs la'ang dge rtsa spel bar mdzad// thang lhas lho sprin cha lugs rta mang gi// gdan drangs 'khor gyis mngon sum rig la 'dud// yar rgyab dpon la'ang mi 'jigs sbyin rtsal sogs// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro rnams bde la bkod// rgyal ba'i gsung rten brtsams chos ches mang pos// skyob pa'i gsung gi phrin las slar bskyangs 'dud// sku rten sgo mang byed po'i 'phrul bzo bo// ma sleb gong du dbyibs byad mngon par mkhyen// phyi nas sleb tshe yon gnas kun yid ches// gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i mngon shes mnga' la 'dud// sngon med rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang la// lha sku sum stong gzigs snang ji bzhin byon// rgyu tshogs bzo khyad 'phrul du myur grub tshe// rab gnas lhas kyang me tog phul la 'dud// sku yi gsang chen rdo rje phag mos bskrun// gsung gi gsang chen u rgyan padmas gnang*// thugs kyi gsang ba bde mchog 'khor los bsgyur// phrin las ye shes mgon pos bsgrubs la 'dud// sku yi gsang ba bsam mi khyab tshul yang*// mkha' 'gros bskrun pa lha bab skyu ra'i gdung*// sku skye du mar a phyi chos sgron mas// byin zhing sprul pas 'gro don mdzad la 'dud// gsung gsang bsam 'das byis dus bgrang phreng zhig

/mgul du bcangs tshe gar song gtad med song*// phyi nyin khu bos gnang bas bla ma la// sangs rgyas mos gus gsang chen brnyes la 'dud// sku 'di'i bla ma shrī dbang ratna yang*// zla 'od gzhon nur gzigs sogs bcu gnyis po// nam yang tshe rabs sngon gyi bla ma'i tshul// sangs rgyas nyid dang dbyer med gzigs la 'dud// tshe rabs kun gyi bla ma u rgyan rgyal// skyob pa'i dus su rdo rje rgyal po'i mtshan// 'dir ni ti sgro gnas su zhal gzigs te// gdams ngag tshe tshad lung bstan gsan la 'dud// nyang po gad steng du yang u rgyan nyid// rnal 'byor tshul gyis cho 'phrul 'khor la gsang*// mtsho skyes rdo rje rtsa gsum dril sgrub tshe// sku bstan dbang gi dngos grub brnyes la 'dud// dgun khrid 'debs dus gser khang nam mkha'i mthongs// bka' brgyud bla ma sgom zhwa bzhes pas gang*// 'gro mgon ngo 'phrod sgam pos mu tig gnang*// gu ru rmi lam gzigs ngor sbed la 'dud// dus gzhan dgun khrid thon tshe sku lus las// rnag khrag zag pas khang pa khengs pa dang*// mthil 'di mar me khengs gyur gcig sbar tshe// kun 'bar spangs rtogs lung ston brnyes la 'dud// sgrub sder 'byon khar chos gos gtsang gsol nas// me tog ches mang 'bar zhing 'bar 'phro'ang gzigs// sgrub sde 'dis kyang bstan la phan che'i tshul// lung bstan rmi lam gsang bar sbed la 'dud// de 'dra'i rnal lam zol gyis ngo mtshar mang*// mgrin pa'i las rlung dbu mar chud pa'i ltas// sgyu ma rmi lam lha dang bla ma'i 'phrul// gsung gi gsang ba bsam mi khyab la 'dud// thugs kyi ting 'dzin chos sku sgo mang can// sgam po bdar gyi dag pa shel ri la// rdo rje phag mos khyod thugs la bris kyang*// khra ba khar gzigs tshul du sbas la 'dud// lhan cig skyes sbyor nyin phyed thun zhig na// sangs rgyas mtshan dpes brgyan pa mngon sum gzigs// stong nyams ngang las bka' brgyud bla ma kun// gsang chen gser mdog sku mang gzigs la 'dud// dbu ru ka tshal gnas su nyin phyed zhig

/spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag stong spyan stong pa// thugs rje chen pos nam mkha' khyab pa gzigs// gsang chen 'jig rten mgon po dngos la 'dud// mdo sngags lha kun gzigs snang dang mthun par// mchod rten ngos la sum stong skur bsdus par// kun kyang rang sems dag pa'i mchod rten zhes// skal ldan ngo sprod dman ngor gsang chen 'dud// de 'dra'i rten mchog ya mtshan sngon med 'di// dang po'i sangs rgyas 'bras spungs mchod rten tshul// skyob pa kho na'i thugs mtsho las 'khrungs pa// thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab la 'dud// phrin las gsang ba ye shes mgon po dang*// chos sgrol ma dang dam can sogs kyis bsgrubs// gzhon nu'i dus na'ang stag lung dmag sogs la// thugs rje zhi ba'i spyan gyis gzigs la 'dud// mtshe'u khar bzhugs dus mchan khung g.yas g.yon nas// snum zhing 'od 'phro'i bya rog zung 'dud gzigs// gdod mar ye nas mgon pos dus rtag par// 'bral med gsang ba'i phrin las bsgrubs la 'dud// mi nyag ring mor ja 'gron 'bul bsdud tshe// tho rangs a phyi chibs zhon khams mo'i tshul// dri med 'od lnga kho mos spro zhes gsungs// 'go nad sel mdzad zhi ba'i las grub 'dud// thog kha gser khang nang du phyag bzhi pa// gtso 'khor gser gyi mdog can brjid nyams kyis// khams gsum zil gnon dang mjal rten 'brel des// gzhan don phrin las rgyas pa'i las grub 'dud// mgon khang rnying mar thod phreng rtsal bsgrubs tshe// gu ru drag pos brgya phreng lcags kyu zhags// gnang ba'i dngos grub srid gsum dbang bsdus pa'i// gsang chen dbang gi phrin las grub la 'dud// yum gyi sku 'dab phyir du rtse bar phebs// zhol khang zhig gi gzim sar nyi shar tshe// zhal nas bya rog gsum thon sgro shad nas// shar phyogs gcig 'phur drag las brtsams la 'dud// dus der sang sing ba la las ngan 'bras// lha khang brang khang ches mang rlung gis bsgyel// mi nor phyugs kyang dgra dang chom pos bcom// las ngan 'phro bcad gus pas bkur la 'dud// 'bri gdan 'khrugs pa'i rtsub longs che dus shig

/mnga' bdag yum gyi tshul 'dzin a phyi la// bdag cag ji ltar 'gyur zhes zhus len du// skyon med bder 'khod dbugs dbyung brnyes la 'dud// gdug can skyid shod dmag dpung lhags tshe yang*// bya rgod slog gyon chu rta sngo bcibs pa'i// a phyi rngam stabs dgra bo'i phyogs bskyod byon// dmag slog dpon bsgral drag las grub la 'dud// mkhar rtse'i rgyab la rang srid phebs tshe yang*// a phyi'i zhal dkar g.yas la grib chags pas// srid 'brel zhol bcog mkhan zhes skyon zhal phab// mal gror dngos byon gsang las grub la 'dud// 'ol kha'i dpung bcas mthil 'dir gnod brtsams tshe// nyang po gzhi nang bang chen zer mi gnyis// kong dmag bteg yod khyed rnams mgyogs byon zhes// chos skyong pho nya'i gsang ba grub la 'dud// dus der kong dmag mi gcig med gyur kyang*// shi gsad med par rdzong dpon 'khor bcas bzung*// a phyis sna drangs mdun bdar rgyab mnan sogs// skyob pas rol rtsed bka' bstsal gnang la 'dud// dus der 'ol kha'i dpung gi mthong snang la// ban dmag sna 'dren can gyi dmag mang po// mig gis blta mi bzod pas zil mnan tshul// dmar po dgra zor yin bka' gnang la bdud// gsang chen gzhan ni mkhas grub ras chen pa// snyung dus 'jigs byed gzugs bsgyur sba dgu can// skyob pas brtul nas 'tshub mar phyir log song*// snyun grol bka' drin gsol btab phul la 'dud// chos khrims rin she rims phog 'chi kha'i tshe// sprul pas mkhar byon bar do 'phrang sgrol btab// gsol ja bzung dar nad 'phral sel sogs dang*// sprul sku rdor rgyal bde sogs mdzad la 'dud// bsam yas zhig sos grub dus gu ru'i sprul// sngags pa 'khor bcas gzims chung 'phyong rtser byon// rab gnas bskul bas dmigs pa'i phyag nas mdzad// phyis nyin pho nyas dngos su bstod la 'dud// spre'u lo'i ti sgro sku mtshams grol dus na// lung bstan chu sogs kha che'i dri mdangs can// rdo rje phag mo'i gsang rdzas dngos grub brda// gnas bstod phul nas dang du bzhes la 'dud// chab tshan rjes zhig grib thor bsnyel ba'i tshe// sku zur g.yas kyi ka gdong gsol cog steng*// 'khor lo bde mchog lo bdun byis pa tsam// nyid skur 'dzin med bstim mdzad grub la 'dud// g.yon gyi ka bar mtshan ldan bu mo zhig

/gsol btab dbang bzhes mdzad 'os min nam gsungs// sku shed chung bas phyag gis nem nem reg /snang la bzung med 'ja' lus reg la 'dud// mos gus stobs bskyed dbang bzhis gsol btab tshe// lung ston bu mo rdo rje phag mo dngos// nye rgyu'i dbang nos zung 'jug chos sku ru// sangs rgyas gyur te gsang chen nyid la 'dud// zhing gzhan 'byon par dgongs pa'i lung bstan bka'// log chos 'dzin la brtse ba'i snying stobs kyi// bstan la 'bungs gsum thob ces bdag la gdams// dbyings nas bden pa'i byin rlabs mdzad la 'dud// sos chos gnang tshe bla ma chos dkon dka'// dpon slob lhan du sgom mdzad sgrub la gdams// rtogs ldan 'phags la'ang da lo thod 'bor zhes// 'phur ba'i grub rtags dang bcas bstan la 'dud// chab tshan dbus su rdor glu bro gar gyis// zol 'phrul mang pos mya ngan 'da' lung bstan// mtshe'u khar phebs nas snyel tshes drug pa la// phyag mchod gtor sogs 'chag med tshul bstan 'dud// sprul sku bsdu tshe bstan pa dbon la gtad// sde pa mgon la'ang lugs gnyis bka' bsgos te// sgrib byang dge 'phel rab gnas bden tshig bcas// rgyal thugs 'od gsal dbyings su thim la 'dud// sngon dus skyob pa mya ngan 'das dus ltar// dgun dus ba lu'i me tog ji snyed 'bar// sa phyogs gzhan du'ang me tog 'bar sogs kyis// rang gzhan mtha' dag yid ches dad la 'dud// nam mkha'i 'ja' dang bar snang me tog char// phyi nang gsang ba'i ngo mtshar ltas mang po// rnam mang rgyas pa'i mdzad pa de lta bus// rtag tu 'gro la thugs rjes skyob la 'dud// sku gdung mchod 'bul grub chen rnam gsum la// mngon dgar 'byon dang klu sgrub thub drung gshegs// ting 'dzin nyams dang lha rdzas mchod 'bul dang*// ri bong btud sogs dag snang sprul la 'dud// sku gdung rin chen gzhal med khang du mchod// dge 'dun bsnyen bkur dpa' bo'i ston mo dang*// skye bo'i sbyin gtong sngar srol las lhag pas// mchod 'bul grub te byin rlabs 'jug la bdud// de ltar skyob pa kun dga' rin chen gyi// bris thang rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di nyid dang*// gong gi le'u gnyis dang bcas pa yis// rnam thar kha skong le'u gsum bsgrubs pas// rtag tu skyob pas rjes bzung chos spyod shog
